name: Mansour Bahrami
milestone_by_age_26: Joined the Iranian national adult tennis team at age 16 and made his Davis Cup debut in 1975 at age 19, representing Iran in international competition.
early_history_summary: Bahrami grew up in extreme poverty in Tehran, where his father worked as a gardener at the Amjadieh Sport Complex. He learned tennis using frying pans and dustpans, not owning a racket until age 13 when a national team player gave him one. He became Iranian junior champion at 15 and joined the national adult team at 16, but the Islamic Revolution in 1979 banned tennis and derailed his career for several years before he emigrated to France.
family_context_summary: Born to a poor family in Tehran; father was a gardener at the Amjadieh Sport Complex. The family lived in one small room. Bahrami worked as a ball boy from age 5 to earn money.
